paragraphs.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadatoyo held Hirotada’s horse standard high and, with the last of his strength, drew the enemy away toward the distant horizon.

units.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadatoyo held Hirotada’s horse standard high and, with the last of his strength, drew the enemy away toward the distant horizon.
units.source_zh: 本多平八郎忠丰高举着广忠的马印，以最后的气力，将敌人引至远远的地平线。

paragraphs.source_zh: 本多平八郎忠丰高举着广忠的马印，以最后的气力，将敌人引至远远的地平线。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing that Nobuhide meant to engage the enemy himself, a man behind him called, “My lord!” It was Hirate Nakatsukasa-no-Taifu Masahide, Kippōshi’s teacher, who had hurried from Nagoya. Nobuhide nodded with a wry smile.

units.source_en: Seeing that Nobuhide meant to engage the enemy himself, a man behind him called, “My lord!”
units.source_zh: 看到信秀有亲自迎战的意思，背后一人道：“主公！”

units.source_en: It was Hirate Nakatsukasa-no-Taifu Masahide, Kippōshi’s teacher, who had hurried from Nagoya.
units.source_zh: 是从那古野赶来的吉法师的老师平手中务大辅政秀。

units.source_en: Nobuhide nodded with a wry smile.
units.source_zh: 信秀苦笑着点点头。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, two headstrong and imposing young commanders rushed from Nobuhide’s side, bearing the long spears in which the Oda clan took such pride. Both had painted the tassels of their spears vermilion. These were the spears that had earned the name “Seven Spears” in the former Battle of Azukizaka.

units.source_en: At that moment, two headstrong and imposing young commanders rushed from Nobuhide’s side, bearing the long spears in which the Oda clan took such pride.
units.source_zh: 此时，信秀身边奔出两个倔强而威武的年轻武将，手持织田家引以为傲的长枪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，信秀身边奔出两个倔强而威武的年轻武将，手持织田家引以为傲的长枪。二人都在长枪穗上涂上了朱红。这便是昔日小豆坂之战中赢得“七条枪”之称的长枪。

paragraphs.source_en: “Oda Magosaburō Nobumitsu has come to face Lord Hirotada!”

units.source_en: “Oda Magosaburō Nobumitsu has come to face Lord Hirotada!”
units.source_zh: “织田孙三郎信光前来会会广忠公。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “织田孙三郎信光前来会会广忠公。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Nakano Matahei of the Seven Spears of Azukizaka is here!”

units.source_en: “Nakano Matahei of the Seven Spears of Azukizaka is here!”
units.source_zh: “小豆坂七条枪之中野又兵卫在此！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “小豆坂七条枪之中野又兵卫在此！”

paragraphs.source_en: When he saw Hirotada fall from his horse, Nakano suddenly leveled his spear to thrust.

units.source_en: When he saw Hirotada fall from his horse, Nakano suddenly leveled his spear to thrust.
units.source_zh: 看到广忠落马，中野突然挺枪欲刺。

paragraphs.source_en: “Wait!” Nobuhide stopped him. “He is already dead.”

units.source_en: “Wait!”
units.source_zh: “等等！”

units.source_en: Nobuhide stopped him. “He is already dead.”
units.source_zh: 信秀止道，“他已经死了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “等等！”信秀止道，“他已经死了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuhide slowly approached the body, took the golden-fan horse standard, and gently closed the dead man’s staring eyes. “Truly admirable!”

paragraphs.source_en: In an instant, silence fell all around, as though everything had ceased to move. Hirate Masahide walked up at a measured pace. “We should make certain. It may not be Hirotada.” He knelt on one knee and was about to lift the armor with his hand.

paragraphs.source_en: Masahide, too, pressed his palms together in prayer.

units.source_en: Masahide, too, pressed his palms together in prayer.
units.source_zh: 政秀也双手合十。

paragraphs.source_zh: 政秀也双手合十。

paragraphs.source_en: Amid all this commotion, the men who had leapt into the stream had vanished without a trace. Ōkubo Shinpachirō, Abe Shirōgorō, and Matsudaira Geki had all disappeared. Someone had evidently rallied the ranks, though no one knew who. The Matsudaira men had lowered their banners and retreated—perhaps in accordance with instructions Honda Heihachirō had given before galloping to Hirotada’s side.

units.source_en: Amid all this commotion, the men who had leapt into the stream had vanished without a trace.

units.source_zh: 大久保新八郎、阿部四郎五郎，还有松平外记都已经消失了。

units.source_zh: 不知是什么人将队伍聚集起来，松平人已经偃旗撤退了，也许是本多平八郎在纵马驰至广忠身边前已有的指示。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在这一阵喧哗之中，那些跳到溪流中的人已经不见踪影。大久保新八郎、阿部四郎五郎，还有松平外记都已经消失了。不知是什么人将队伍聚集起来，松平人已经偃旗撤退了，也许是本多平八郎在纵马驰至广忠身边前已有的指示。

paragraphs.source_en: The sun had already climbed high. With only its vanguard present, the Oda army naturally could not give chase. The Matsudaira had retreated precisely because they understood this, but the outcome was already clear.
